summary: Tested the Team Ristoro selection on the public availability link and the Mansione auto-sync, on both backend and frontend. Working: the public GET returns only the event's ristoro teams. Submitting with no team or a foreign team returns 400. Submitting with a valid team creates the Da classificare link with team_id, ruolo set to the team name and mansione_auto=true. The UI dropdown, error message, hide/clear on preference change and the no-ristoro info message all work. The mobile 390px form works. In the mask, team and mansione keep through Da classificare -> Volontario -> Staff, Mansione follows a team change, and a manual Mansione is kept on a later team change (persisted mansione_auto=false). Two bugs found: renaming a team does NOT update the Mansione of auto links, and a re-submission of the public form overwrites a manual Mansione and team on already-classified links.

critical.issue: Team rename sync never runs. The sync code (db.staff.update_many team_id + mansione_auto -> ruolo) was added in _update(), which is only used by the non-org-scoped crud_routes branch (server.py ~line 637). Teams are org-scoped, so the PUT goes to the org-scoped _u (server.py ~1591-1632), which has no sync. Reproduced: team renamed 'TEST_Ristoro KM 20' -> 'KM 21', but the staff link with mansione_auto=true kept ruolo='TEST_Ristoro KM 20'. Fix: in org-scoped _u, after update_one add `if coll == 'teams' and clean.get('nome'): await db.staff.update_many(oq(user, team_id=item_id, mansione_auto=True), {'$set': {'ruolo': clean['nome']}})`

minor.issue: When the person already has a link (any category), team_set {team_id, ruolo, mansione_auto:true} is always applied. This overwrites a manual Mansione (mansione_auto=false) and the admin-chosen team, even after the person is classified as Staff/Volontario. Reproduced: Staff link with ruolo='Addetto ristoro', mansione_auto=false; after re-submitting the form with another ristoro team, it became team=TEST_Ristoro KM 21, ruolo='TEST_Ristoro KM 21', mansione_auto=true. This breaks the 'manual Mansione never overwritten automatically' rule. Suggest: for an existing link, set ruolo/mansione_auto only if cur.mansione_auto or not cur.ruolo, and maybe only update team_id while the link is da_classificare.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the backend bug, Mansione in Staff/Volontari/Da classificare keeps the old team name after a rename via the Team tab (EntityManager PUT /teams)

issues: Data di nascita uses a native <input type=date> (browser default picker) instead of the shadcn calendar. Same pattern as before, not new.

action_items: Add the team-rename -> staff.ruolo sync (mansione_auto=true only, org-scoped) to the org-scoped PUT handler in crud_routes (server.py ~1591). The sync in _update() is dead for teams.
In anagrafica.ensure_link, do not overwrite ruolo/team_id of an existing link when mansione_auto is false (or when the link is already classified)

rca of the issue: Rename sync: the hook was put in the generic _update() helper, but org-scoped crud routes run their own inline update in _u and never call _update(), so the code is never reached for teams. Re-submit overwrite: ensure_link builds team_set unconditionally and applies it to any existing link, without checking cur.mansione_auto or the category.
